channel.title: Widgetworks Release Notes
channel.description: Release announcements for Widgetworks (deterministic gaia-eval fixture).

item.title: v2.4.0 — Offline mode ships
item.description: Widgetworks 2.4.0 adds full offline mode: projects open and save without a connection and sync when one returns.

item.title: v2.3.1 — Hotfix for sync loop
item.description: Fixes a bug where interrupted uploads could leave the sync engine retrying the same batch indefinitely.

item.title: v2.3.0 — New importer for legacy projects
item.description: Adds an importer for pre-2.0 project archives, including attachments and revision history.
